title: Running box office by year
statementMd:
For each release year show total gross that year and the cumulative gross up to that year (ignoring unknown grosses; years with only unknown gross are excluded). Oldest first.

Expected columns: `release_year`, `gross`, `cumulative`.

Tables: `movies`, `directors`, `reviews`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
hints: Aggregate per year, then running `SUM() OVER`.
solutionMd:
```sql
WITH y AS (SELECT release_year, SUM(gross_millions) AS gross FROM movies WHERE gross_millions IS NOT NULL GROUP BY release_year) SELECT release_year, gross, SUM(gross) OVER (ORDER BY release_year) AS cumulative FROM y ORDER BY release_year;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
